author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a swaying steady beat, high and low, loud and soft, and playing together, using the song everyone sings to make someone feel special.

classes.title: Sway the birthday song
classes.goal: Hear the whole birthday song and sway to its gentle beat together.

mathTarget.parentLine: A swaying beat that comes back again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Hold hands and sway side to side, a big step on each first beat.
classes.childAction: Sway and clap with the birthday song.
classes.bridge: The beat sways like a balloon on a string: swing, and swing.

intro.caption: Let's sway like balloons
intro.parentCue: hold hands and sway side to side

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling the steady beat, together.

classes.title: Birthday taps
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on each beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more and no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for every beat. Any key is right.
classes.bridge: Each beat is a candle on the cake; one tap lights each one.

intro.caption: One beat, one tap
intro.parentCue: tap your child's shoulder on each beat

games.caption: Tap for teddy's birthday
games.parentCue: Sing the words softly while you tap

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds and tap the matching side of the piano.

mathTarget.parentLine: Low sounds live on the left, high sounds on the right

classes.parentPrompt: Growl and crouch for the bear; flap your arms and reach up for the bird.
classes.childAction: Bear sound: tap the left side. Bird sound: tap the right.
classes.bridge: Happy birthday, dear friend: the tune jumps up high like a bird.

intro.caption: The bear lives low, the bird flies high
intro.parentCue: point left for the bear, right for the bird

games.caption: Hear the big jump up
games.parentCue: Lift your child's arms on the high note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high and low sounds.

classes.title: Party loud, secret soft
classes.goal: Tap the beat with big loud taps, then with tiny soft taps.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same tap can be big or small

classes.parentPrompt: Use strong arms for loud taps; whisper and tiptoe your fingers for soft.
classes.childAction: Loud: big party taps. Soft: tiny secret taps.
classes.bridge: Loud taps are a party cheer; soft taps keep a birthday surprise.

intro.caption: A party cheer, a secret surprise
intro.parentCue: loud means strong arms, never banging

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing loud and soft.

classes.title: Turtle and bunny party
classes.goal: Follow the music as it slows like a turtle and speeds like a bunny.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same tune, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers up your child's back, slowly then quickly, with the music.
classes.childAction: Turtle music: slow taps. Bunny music: quick taps.
classes.bridge: Slow taps are turtle steps; quick taps are bunny hops to the party.

intro.caption: Turtle time, then bunny time
intro.parentCue: slow down if the taps get wild

games.caption: Bunny sings happy birthday
games.parentCue: Same tune, now quick and light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following slow and fast music.

classes.title: Musical statues party
classes.goal: Tap while the music plays and hold still when it stops.

mathTarget.parentLine: When the sound stops, the hands stop too

classes.parentPrompt: Freeze like a party statue when the music stops; cheer when it starts again.
classes.childAction: Tap while the music plays. Freeze when it stops.
classes.bridge: Music on, the party dances; music off, everyone is a statue.

intro.caption: Tap, tap... freeze!
intro.parentCue: make freezing silly, like a statue

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for stop and go.

classes.title: Guess the music game
classes.goal: Listen and switch between games: high and low, loud and soft, slow and fast.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound: high or low, loud or soft?

classes.parentPrompt: Before each picture, ask: bear or bird? Loud or soft? Cheer every guess.
classes.childAction: Guess the game, then tap high, low, loud, soft, slow or fast.
classes.bridge: Every sound dresses up for the party: bear, bird, turtle or bunny.

intro.caption: Which game is it?
intro.parentCue: let your child guess first; every guess counts

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling sounds apart and switching games.

classes.title: Sing it for each other
classes.goal: Make the song together: the grown-up plays the tune, the child keeps the beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together into one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and watch your child; if they stop, keep playing and smile.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat on any key while your grown-up plays.
classes.bridge: The tune is the cake; your beat is the candles on top.

intro.caption: I play, you tap
intro.parentCue: sit side by side at the piano

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, two jobs.

classes.title: Happy birthday, teddy!
classes.goal: Play the whole song from the first note to the last, then bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on, and ends; we finish together

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the birthday guest; play the tune, then cheer and bow together.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat to the very end, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: The last 'to you' is the end: pretend to blow the candles.

intro.caption: A song for teddy!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front as the birthday guest

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
